story.p1: Our founder is a Turkish financial expert with over 10 years of professional trading experience. The vision was to combine human insight with machine precision to cut through market noise.

mtf.title: Multi-Timeframe (MTF)
mtf.description: Looking at a single timeframe is misleading. Our algorithm analyzes trends across M15, H1, H4, and Daily charts simultaneously and generates signals when all align.
bullets: Trend Alignment: All timeframes must align for 80%+ success rate.
Noise Filter: Momentary M1 moves against H4 trend are filtered out.
Dynamic Support: Support levels from higher timeframes are auto-drawn.

patterns.title: Pattern Detection
patterns.description: Scans classic technical analysis patterns (Head & Shoulders, Double Bottom, Flag) in milliseconds and catches opportunities the human eye might miss.
bullets: Candlestick: Bullish Engulfing, Hammer, Doji, etc.
Price Target: The theoretical target of the pattern is shown on the chart.

ai.title: AI and Machine Learning
ai.description: Go beyond rule-based (algorithmic) systems. Our ML model uses probability distributions learned from 24 years of data.
bullets: Sentiment Analysis: Measures market psychology from news.
Volume Weight: Filters fake-outs with volume analysis.
Continuous Learning: Model updates itself for new market conditions.
